beersRules.rationale: Benzodiazepines increase risk of cognitive impairment, delirium, falls, and motor vehicle accidents in older adults.
beersRules.recommendation: Avoid benzodiazepines in elderly patients for insomnia or agitation.

beersRules.rationale: Long-acting benzodiazepines accumulate in elderly bodies due to prolonged half-life, causing excessive sedation and falls.
beersRules.recommendation: Avoid long-acting benzodiazepines in older adults.

beersRules.rationale: First-generation antihistamines are highly anticholinergic, risking confusion, dry mouth, constipation, and urinary retention in older adults.
beersRules.recommendation: Avoid diphenhydramine and anticholinergic sedatives in patients 65 and older.

timingRules.advice: Separate taking Ciprofloxacin and multivalent electrolytes by at least 2 hours to avoid reduced antibiotic absorption.

contraindications.description: NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandins, causing acute reduction in glomerular filtration and worsening Chronic Kidney Disease.
NSAIDs damage the gastric mucosal barrier, risking active ulcer perforation or gastrointestinal bleeding.
Beta-blockers can trigger severe bronchospasm in patients with Asthma or hyperreactive airways.

foodInteractions.description: Large amounts of grapefruit juice inhibit intestinal CYP3A4, increasing blood concentrations of Atorvastatin and raising muscle toxicity risk.
Alcohol produces additive central nervous system depression with Benzodiazepines, increasing risk of profound sedation and respiratory depression.
